I replied to Tobias in your DM. I confirmed the new time: his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Tamarack rollout is Thursdays at 9:30 from now on.

I didn't change anything on his calendar, since he said no action was needed. I also can't store it anywhere else. The note stays in that DM, and he can ask me about it there. I offered to add it as a recurring calendar event if he tells me the timezone and how long the call runs.
